training: mixed-L baseline trajectories; same sampled cache-miss candidates for LR/XGB/stateMLP/qvMLP, no test or validation queries used for weight fitting/checkpoint selection
pruning_label: retain iff admitted_neighbors>0 OR node in final baseline top10 for its L; conservative contribution proxy, not counterfactual risk
ET_label: actual GT Recall@10 of current exact-scored prefix top10 at a beam boundary, supervised offline only; 17 live features at runtime
ET: native DiskANN learned recall estimator; stop if prediction>=threshold, only after >=K exact candidates; related-strategy implementation, not a claimed faithful DARTH/LAET reproduction
baseline: 64 distinct L settings incl all learned L choices; stronger finely tuned baseline
learning_budget: 8 common L settings x8 threshold/preset settings per family; combined ET+pruning receives8 predeclared threshold pairs per L, not a larger Cartesian budget
gate_cache: cache hits protected consistently across all pruning families; ET may stop whole search at beam boundary
training_and_timing: isolated native library; no modification of original DiskANN source or previous models; all inference, feature assembly and q-v memory access timed; model/index load excluded
IO: submitted SSD requests; Linux reader O_DIRECT, OS page cache bypassed; static BFS cache and per-config query warmup
plots: empirical per-metric nondominated frontiers at ACTUAL measured Recall; marker=real configuration, lines guide the eye; standard-target linear frontier interpolation recorded only as descriptive estimates, never called single-config measurements; P95/QPS not linearly interpolated for deployable claims
validation_selection: for each Recall target and objective choose minimal validation cost/maxQPS under empirical validation Recall constraint; lock before test; report actual test Recall and feasibility separately
test_curve: fixed validation-independent grid also fully evaluated on held-out queries for descriptive achievable frontiers; not used to retrain, enlarge a method budget, or claim unbiased deployment parameter selection
repeats: validation all grid once; test all grid once; objective-frontier/validation-selected configs two additional repeats; final frontiers use3-repeat medians wherever selected
limits: previously observed original test queries; exploratory benchmark, not new confirmatory set
same finite configuration count does not guarantee global optimality
ET trained on unpruned prefixes; ET+pruning faces trajectory shift, evaluated live
q-v input uses full base vectors in DRAM; extra memory explicitly reported
